products.title: No. 10 × 7/8 in. Phillips Pan-Head Sheet-Metal Screws
products.category: Hardware > Hardware Accessories > Hardware Fasteners > Screws > Sheet Metal Screws
products.sourceDescription: No. 10; zinc-plated; pan head; 7/8 in. length; Phillips drive; sharp point; self-tapping; coarse thread; steel; indoor use; boxed packaging.
products.descriptionHtml:
Steel sheet-metal screws with a zinc-plated finish, pan head, Phillips drive, and sharp self-tapping point.

  • Size: No. 10 × 7/8 in.
  • Drive: Phillips
  • Finish: Zinc-plated
  • Use: Indoor

Starter listing: price and stock are example values. Confirm pack quantity, supplier, and retail price in Shopify Admin before live sales.

products.title: 3-Piece LM317 Adjustable Voltage Regulator Module
products.category: Hardware > Power & Electrical Supplies > Voltage Transformers & Regulators > Voltage Regulators
products.sourceDescription: 3-piece LM317 adjustable regulator module. The source listing describes 1.2–37 V output, 4.2–40 V input, 1.5 A minimum and 2.2 A typical output current, and -55 to +150 °C operating temperature. Confirm limits against the manufacturer's datasheet before sale.
products.descriptionHtml:
Three LM317 adjustable voltage regulator modules for electronics projects and bench prototyping.

  • Adjustable output: 1.2–37 V
  • Input: 4.2–40 V
  • Current: 1.5 A minimum; 2.2 A typical as stated by the source listing
  • Operating temperature: -55 to +150 °C as stated by the source listing

Starter listing: specifications come from the source dataset listing and should be checked against the manufacturer's datasheet. Price and stock are example values.
